input: I drive for a ride-hailing app and my essential cost is R$ 2,800 a month. How much should I have in my emergency fund?

checks.description: Uses the 6 to 12 month range for variable income
Calculates the minimum fund in reais (6 × R$ 2,800 = R$ 16,800)
Calculates the maximum fund in reais (12 × R$ 2,800 = R$ 33,600)
Explains that the fund needs fast redemption
